_doc: SSP arm of the round-2 pipeline (same parameterization, repair, candidate selection and per-challenge iteration budget as configs/round2.json). Stages use the subpixel-smoothed projection (Hammond et al., Opt. Express 33, 33620 (2025)): a short finite-beta phase (8, 32) finds the topology, then beta = inf (binary except a ~1 px interface layer, still differentiable) shape-optimizes it, and the final straight-through stage simulates the repaired binary design with the SSP(beta = inf) gradient instead of tanh(beta = 64).
